text:
alex: rolling a staged canary for v3.2.2 in us-west-2 in ~2m (change window 02:00-03:00 UTC). preflight looked ok but wanted eyes after first 5%.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: preflight checks PASS. Canary group created (5% traffic) and routing active.

mira: linking telemetry https://metrics.internal/redwood/canary/17455  p95 ~+12% and a handful of 400ms+ tail spikes since t+2m. no 5xxs.

oliver: seeing KV-cache eviction bursts on canary-sidecar pods (us-west-2). evict rate ~2.5x at 02:03. mem footprint stable.

sam: is this new for 3.2.2? did quantization change?

alex: 3.2.2 includes an attention cache tweak. could be interacting with longer sequences. options: pause at 5% and pin to v3.2.1-quant for canary, or rollback canary to v3.2.1 full, or proceed and monitor (risky).

mira: vote: pause + pin to quant variant to reduce churn while we triage. :raised_hand:

oliver: hold + pin. logs show repeated evict/miss churn:
```
[02:03:10] kvcache: evict key=ctx-1024 shard=4 reason=mem_pressure
[02:03:10] model: req=id=zz12 seq_len=3584 latency=462ms
[02:03:11] kvcache: miss key=ctx-1024
```

sre-oncall: no elevated 5xxs. we should avoid widening traffic until evictions subside.

alex: @deploy-bot suspend further percent increases. can someone execute a canary pin to v3.2.1-quant for the us-west-2 allocation?

deploy-bot: Deploybot: traffic increase suspended per request.

sam: I'll pin now and update the rollback playbook steps. pinning canary allocation (canary-us-west-2-3) -> v3.2.1-quant.

deploy-bot: Deploybot: canary pinned to v3.2.1-quant (allocation: canary-us-west-2-3).

alex: thanks. watch p95 + eviction metrics for next 10m. if stable we can reconvene and decide a slow bump to 10% or continue investigation.

mira: adding to release notes: "Temporary pin of us-west-2 canary to v3.2.1-quant due to observed KV cache eviction-related latency with v3.2.2 canary." ok to commit?

oliver: fine. also filing INV-2031 for ML/infra triage to trace cache behavior across seq length distribution.

sre-oncall: snapshot 5m after pin: eviction rate trending down to baseline, p95 moving toward normal. will attach 10m snapshot once available.

alex: good. leave this thread open for 15m; if nothing regresses we'll close and continue the staged rollout on a guarded cadence. thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
